player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} ({piece}). Ko te hoariri ko ({opp}).
Tukua nga neke ki '[a2 a3]' (ma te taha ki te taha).
- He neke noa ko te haere whakamua ki tetahi waahi takoto noa e tata ana.
- He muru ko te peke atu ki tetahi kaiwhai e tata ana, ka tae ki te waahi takoto noa i tua.
Ko te muru kotahi e whakaputa ai {score_per_capture} ponga.
Ka mutu te whai ki muri i {max_moves} nga neke, ki te wa kaore he neke ture mo tetahi kaitakaro.

invalid_move.bad_format: He hōputu hē. Whakamahia te '[a2 a3]'.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Ehara i te mea ko koe te pūtake.

game_action.captured: Kaitakaro {player_id} i muru i tetahi kaiwhai! (+{score_per_capture})

outcome.no_pieces: Kāore he tākaro o te kaitakaro {player_id}.
outcome.cannot_move: Kāore e taea te neke a {player_id} kaitākaro.
outcome.higher_score: He nui ake te whiwhinga hopu.
outcome.move_limit: Kua tae ki te rohe nekehanga.
